audit_metadata.estimand_clarification: All outputs estimate cross-sectional prevalence or survey-reported lifetime doctor diagnoses in adult examination cohorts; they do NOT forecast 10-year prospective future incidence.
audit_metadata.type_2_distinction_note: CDC NHANES question DIQ010 asks whether a doctor has ever diagnosed diabetes; it does not differentiate Type 1 from Type 2 diabetes. The target is accurately designated 'Diagnosed Diabetes'.

diabetes.question_text: Other than during pregnancy, have you ever been told by a doctor or health professional that you have diabetes or sugar diabetes?

lifestyle_and_body_size_only.description: Restricted to body measures, demographics, and lifestyle factors (no lab tests, no vitals)

hypertension.question_text: Have you ever been told by a doctor or other health professional that you had hypertension, also called high blood pressure?

lifestyle_and_body_size_only.description: Restricted to body measures, demographics, and lifestyle factors (no lab tests, no vitals)

hypertension_without_measured_bp.description: All clinical features except measured blood pressure exam readings (systolic_bp, diastolic_bp, pulse_bpm)

high_cholesterol.question_text: Have you ever been told by a doctor or other health professional that your blood cholesterol level was high?

lifestyle_and_body_size_only.description: Restricted to body measures, demographics, and lifestyle factors (no lab tests, no vitals)

high_cholesterol_without_lipid_values.description: All clinical features except measured lipid panel biomarkers (total_cholesterol, hdl_cholesterol, triglycerides, ldl_cholesterol)

heart_disease.question_text: Has a doctor or other health professional ever told you that you had coronary heart disease, angina, or a heart attack?

lifestyle_and_body_size_only.description: Restricted to body measures, demographics, and lifestyle factors (no lab tests, no vitals)

stroke.question_text: Has a doctor or other health professional ever told you that you had a stroke?

copd.question_text: Has a doctor or other health professional ever told you that you had emphysema or chronic bronchitis?
